_provenance.purpose: Spoken words for AMOUNT tokens (currency symbol, thousands separator, decimal, percent) - the one data source shared by faTextNormalize.ts, textNormalize.ts (matcher canonicalize), src-tauri/src/fa/text.rs and cloud/fa_engine.py. Cardinal magnitudes still come from fa-cardinal-<lang>.json.
_provenance.why: normalizeForForcedAlignment used to DROP any token that was not a bare integer, so '$11,000.' never reached forced alignment and the neighbouring words were stretched over the amount's speech. An amount now reads as its spoken words: '$11,000' -> 'eleven thousand dollars'.
_provenance.digestNote: Deliberately NOT part of cloud/sync_core.py pack_digests (vocab + cardinal only): adding this file must not change the alignment cache key of any chunk plan that carries no amount. Amount-bearing plans change key through their chunk TEXT (plan hash), which is the honest reason to re-align them.
grammar: An amount token is one whitespace token that, after edge punctuation is stripped, is: [currency symbol] number [%] or number [currency symbol|%], where number is digits with thousands separators and/or a decimal part. A bare integer with none of those (2001, 10) is NOT an amount and keeps its existing reading (including the year reading).
en separators: ',' thousands, '.' decimal. es/fr/de/pt: '.' thousands, ',' decimal (the convention canonicalize() already applies).

Reading: cardinal(integer part) [pointWord + each decimal digit as its own cardinal] [currency word: 'one' form iff the value is exactly 1 with no decimals, else 'other'] [percentWord]. Currency and percent are spoken AFTER the number.
The integer part is always the plain cardinal, never the year reading ('$1998' is money, not a year).
